starting_state: An editable Canva presentation is open with a heading text box on the page; nothing is selected. The window is narrow, so some toolbar or panel controls are collapsed.
user_instruction: Apply an outline effect to the heading

expected_next_action.objective: Click once on the text box on the page to select it.

failure_criteria: Performs destructive recovery without the user choosing it.
